title: Skirmish AI tuning definition
description: DR-14 / doc 28. The skirmish commander's tuning, in the same shape and spirit as schema.weapon.json: CLAUDE.md forbids hand-editing stats in code, so these files are the runtime source and the AiTuning class exists only to be proved equal to them by aituninggate. The numbers here DRIVE the runtime - CatalogueFiles.RegisterAiTuning registers them into the world before tick 0 and SkirmishAI composes a commander from World.GetAiTuning - so editing a value in one of these files changes the game. This kind carries a safety argument the others do not: the commander's numbers used to be compiled, so two LAN peers agreed on them by construction, and the table is therefore folded into World.CatalogueChecksum, which the LAN hello, saves and replays already compare and refuse a mismatch on. The tuning id is the sim's wire identity and stays a compiled map (AiCatalogue.TuningIdOf); the file names the thing, the map names the number.

id.description: AI tuning rows take the ai_ prefix rather than a faction prefix: a commander's taste and a difficulty rung belong to no side.

name.description: Player-facing name, shown in the skirmish setup menu. British spelling. Must pass legal sweep.

kind.description: Which family this row belongs to, and therefore which keys it must author and which it is refused for authoring. DR-14 keeps personality and difficulty ORTHOGONAL - personality is a commander's taste in wave size, difficulty is how good it is - because the review that produced the ladder found the two conflated. A personality row authors act_every_ticks, wave_size, anti_air_cap, anti_air_garrison and faction_defence_cap; a rung row authors beat_numerator, beat_denominator, harvesters_per_refinery, starting_credit_handicap, producer_cap, surplus_reserve and surplus_window_ticks. The loader refuses either family's keys in the other's file, so the orthogonality is enforced rather than merely described. Per-family required keys cannot be expressed here, since the gate that reads this schema applies one required list per directory, so the loader carries that half and reports a missing key with the file name and its own line number.

act_every_ticks.description: PERSONALITY ONLY. The commander's decision beat in sim ticks at 15Hz: it acts on ticks divisible by this and is silent between them. 15 is one decision per second and is the beat that has always shipped. The rung then scales it, so this is the number a difficulty is applied to rather than the final beat. Must be at least 1; the commander takes Tick modulo it.

wave_size.description: PERSONALITY ONLY. Fighting units that must stand ready before an attack wave goes out, and the number that makes the shape of the opponent. Read twice: the wave leaves at wave_size plus the garrison, and the garrison itself is half of this with a floor of 2, so a smaller wave also means a smaller home guard. Set by Balance under A11.

anti_air_cap.description: PERSONALITY ONLY. P8-17 (ADR-072, decision D10): the most anti-air units the commander builds once it has SEEN an enemy aircraft with its own eyes (a visible cell, and never an undetected cloaked one). Inert until then, which is what keeps every ground-only match and every golden byte-identical. From the first sighting the commander keeps one anti-air unit more than the most enemy flyers it has seen at once, and this caps that target. Authored as the personality's own wave_size, so no commander holds more anti-air than one wave's worth of army. 0 means the commander never builds anti-air. Set by Balance under A11.

anti_air_garrison.description: PERSONALITY ONLY. P8-17 (ADR-072): how many of the commander's anti-air units, lowest entity id first, are held in the base garrison rather than sent out. They guard the base against aircraft and never join an attack wave. Every anti-air unit beyond this number escorts the harvesters, and closes on any flyer seen raiding one. Authored as 2, the floor the ground garrison already keeps. Set by Balance under A11.

beat_numerator.description: RUNG ONLY. Numerator of the ratio the rung scales the personality's beat by. A RATIO rather than a multiplier because Brutal needs two thirds exactly and CLAUDE.md forbids any floating-point type anywhere in /sim; the commander computes act_every_ticks * beat_numerator / beat_denominator in integer arithmetic and floors the result at 1. A larger ratio is a SLOWER commander, since the beat is a gap between decisions.

beat_denominator.description: RUNG ONLY. Denominator of the same ratio. The division TRUNCATES, which is deliberate and load-bearing: 15 * 2 / 3 is 10. Must be at least 1; the commander divides by it.

harvesters_per_refinery.description: RUNG ONLY. How many harvesters the commander keeps working per refinery it owns, and the ladder's honest strength knob: more mining, not free money, and income a player can go after and take away. 1 is the rule that has always shipped. Set by Balance under A11.

starting_credit_handicap.description: RUNG ONLY. Credits granted to the AI seat at match setup, and the one declared cheat GDD line 76 permits, allowed at the top rung and nowhere else. It is applied by whatever BUILDS the match and never by the commander: SkirmishAI mutates nothing, and a replay re-runs the bare command stream with no AI attached, so a commander that granted itself credits would desync every replay of its own match. Any value above 0 must be labelled as cheating wherever the rung is offered to a player.

faction_defence_cap.description: PERSONALITY ONLY. P8-22 (ADR-079): the most of its own side's armed faction defence (World.BuildableFactionDefence: the Bastion or the Shroud Nest today) the commander keeps standing. The ladder buys the first exactly as before, from cost plus 1500; every one after it is bought only from a SUSTAINED surplus (the rung's surplus_reserve and surplus_window_ticks), and only once no producer the rung's producer_cap still allows is due. Authored as the personality's own ground garrison, half its wave_size with a floor of 2, so a base keeps as many signature guns as fighters at home; the number is transcribed from that rule, not derived from wave_size when loaded, so a row that moves wave_size re-reads this copy. 0 or 1 means none is bought from surplus. How many guns guard a base is taste, so it sits beside the wave size rather than on the rung. Set by Balance under A11.

producer_cap.description: RUNG ONLY. P8-22 (ADR-079, decision D7): the most barracks, and separately the most factories, the commander holds at once. The ladder still buys the first of each; another is bought only when every producer of its kind already has an order on its line (that kind is the bottleneck) and the surplus is sustained. 1 is the ladder's own one of each and nothing more; D7's caps are Easy 1, Normal 2, Hard 3 and Brutal 3. Must be at least 1. Set by Balance under A11.

surplus_reserve.description: RUNG ONLY. P8-22 (ADR-079): credits the commander keeps back from everything it buys out of surplus. A further producer or faction defence is bought only while its price still leaves this much, and every Produce after the first in a decision beat only while that beat's orders still leave it; the first order of a beat is placed exactly as before, on its own price. Nothing else in the beat reads its commitments: the building's own test does not count an engineer ordered earlier in the beat, the anti-air answer tests its own price, the MCV a floor of 3500 and the harvester none. So a beat that opens at or above this can end below it by the first army order's price, plus that of any engineer, anti-air answer or harvester it also ordered. Authored as 4500, the superweapon rung's credit test and the dearest in the ladder. No surplus purchase is ordered on credits the reserve keeps, but a beat can still end below it, as said above (ADR-079 section 2). The number is transcribed from that rung's literal in SkirmishAI.cs, not read from it, so a row that moves the literal re-reads this copy. Set by Balance under A11.

surplus_window_ticks.description: RUNG ONLY. P8-22 (ADR-079): how long, in sim ticks at 15Hz, the treasury must have stood at or above surplus_reserve on every decision beat, unbroken, before the surplus counts as SUSTAINED and the commander invests it in another producer or faction defence. A beat below the reserve starts the window again. Authored as 4500 (five minutes) and measured by spendprobe at the base: of the 423 stretches a Normal or Hard treasury spent at or above 4500 and then lost before its match ended, 357 lasted under two minutes, one between two and three, none between three and five and 65 five minutes or more, so a bank that has stood for five minutes is income rather than one delivery. 1800, the near edge of that gap, was measured too and ended matches so early that fewer than half of pillargate's sweep launched a superweapon (F8). Set by Balance under A11.
